summary: Iteration_9 (both) — Batch 3 (Lord HP HUD + Lord name / cosmetics shop / rulebook PDF / Eventi tab). BACKEND (6/6 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_batch3_cosmetics_rulebook.py): (1) Login qa.lord@example.com OK; GET /api/profile returns hero.name ('Sir Aldric', str≥3) and cosmetics {lord_skin, castle_skin, owned[list]}. (2) PATCH /api/account/settings {lord_name:'Sir Test'} → 200, GET /profile hero.name='Sir Test' while display_name unchanged ('QA Lord'); short name 'AB' → 400; restored to 'Sir Aldric'. (3) GET /api/store/cosmetics returns 10 skins (6 lord + 4 castle) with fields key,name,rubies,rarity,owned,equipped and rubies balance (int); lord_frost_warden & castle_dragon_keep marked owned+equipped for QA. (4) POST /store/cosmetics/buy already-owned lord_frost_warden → 409; unknown key → 404; buying lord_forest_ranger (300 rubies) → 200 with bought:true, rubies decreased by 300, profile.cosmetics.lord_skin='lord_forest_ranger' (test also verified via subsequent GETs). (5) POST /store/cosmetics/equip {kind:'lord', key:'lord_frost_warden'} → 200 profile.cosmetics.lord_skin='lord_frost_warden'; equip not-owned 'lord_golden_emperor' → 403; equip {kind:'castle', key:null} → 200 castle_skin null; re-equip castle_dragon_keep → 200. (6) GET /api/docs/regolamento.pdf (no auth) → 200, content-type=application/pdf, size > 100KB. FRONTEND (390x844 web preview, logged as qa.lord): Bottom tab bar has EXACTLY 6 tabs in order Battaglia → Regno → Dominio → Esercito → Eventi → Social, tab-events sits between Esercito and Social. tab-events opens events-hub-screen with all 9 tiles present (hub-daily 60/100, hub-weekly 30/100, hub-login 'Giorno 1/7 · premio da ritirare', hub-event 'Assedio del Reame · energia 10/10', hub-dungeons '8 ingressi gratis oggi · tier max 3', hub-titan 'Ogre Warlord · PV 92% · 461.0K', hub-achievements '0/40', hub-codex, hub-shop), each with an illustrated background image and live subtitle text (points/energy/entries). Navigation verified: hub-daily → /events/quests; hub-shop → /shop → shop-screen. ResourceBar chip res-rubies-shop opens /shop. Shop /shop shows skin-shop container with skins-lord (6 cards: lord_forest_ranger, lord_crimson_paladin, lord_frost_warden, lord_shadow_reaper, lord_dragon_knight, lord_golden_emperor) and skins-castle (4: castle_winter_citadel, castle_elven_palace, castle_obsidian_fortress, castle_dragon_keep) horizontal lists; skin cards show artwork + rarity chips (RARO/EPICO/…); tapping equip-lord_frost_warden fires toast 'Skin indossata' (verified in screenshot /tmp/it9_shop_after.png); unequip-lord (Predefinito) sets skin null (button becomes disabled); re-equipping lord_frost_warden works; buy-* buttons exist for all 7 not-owned cosmetic skins + IAP tiers + crates; Kingdom castle art and Battle lord art render without red-screen. Social tab: social-screen has hub-chat + hub-war + hub-boss tiles with art; hub-chat → chat-screen with channel-Globale + channel-Alleanza chips + chat-input + chat-send-button; sent test message on Globale ('QA test 11272') — message text appears in the message list. Battle tab (qa.lord Auto ON): battle-scene renders with lord-hp-bar visible; lord-hp-bar-name='Sir Aldric' matches hero.name, lord-hp-bar-sub='Lv 38 · Potenza 3144' (contains 'Lv' and 'Potenza'), lord-hp-bar-pct='92%'; hero card shows lord-name='Sir Aldric', lord-level-power='Lv 38 · Potenza 3146', player-name='Giocatore: QA Lord'. rename-lord-button opens rename-sheet with rename-input + rename-save-button; typed 'Sir QA Test' → save → lord-name and lord-hp-bar-name both updated; restored to 'Sir Aldric' (verified persisted). Profile screen: identity-panel present with display-name-input, rename-button, lord-name-input, rename-lord-profile-button; rules-pdf-button also present (opens EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/api/docs/regolamento.pdf). Only console noise: pre-existing pointerEvents / textShadow / tintColor / shadow* RN-web deprecation warnings + a couple 401s from ping polls — no red screen, no functional errors. No deprecated Expo package usage detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). Final state restored: lord name='Sir Aldric', lord skin=lord_frost_warden, castle skin=castle_dragon_keep (confirmed at end of pytest module teardown + FE flows).
critical_code_review_comments: Cosmetics catalog data-shape is stable and spec-consistent: exactly 10 SKUs (6 lord + 4 castle), each with {key,name,rubies,rarity,owned,equipped}. Endpoint returns rubies balance at top level. See /app/backend/app/routers/store.py + /app/backend/app/domain/cosmetics.py.

PATCH /api/account/settings correctly decouples lord_name from display_name (updates hero.name only) and enforces min-length validation (returns 400 for 2-char input). Restored to canonical value cleanly.

POST /store/cosmetics/buy has proper error semantics: 409 for already-owned, 404 for unknown key; success path auto-equips and deducts rubies atomically (rubies delta EXACTLY equal to sku.rubies verified).
POST /store/cosmetics/equip returns 403 not_owned for keys the user has not purchased and accepts key:null to unequip (spec-consistent 'Predefinito' path).
Public rulebook endpoint GET /api/docs/regolamento.pdf is unauthenticated, returns application/pdf, > 100KB — safe for anonymous PDF viewers/download.

Events tab (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/events.tsx) uses HubTile with live subtitles wired to server data (quests/points, weekly event countdown, dungeon entries, titan hp), and per-tile art via hubArt(). Navigation targets match spec (quests / weekly / dungeons / titan / achievements / codex / shop).

Battle scene lord HUD (BattleScene.tsx) renders lord-hp-bar with name from profile.hero.name — kept in sync with the hero card via profile refetch after PATCH lord_name (verified: hero card + HP bar both updated after rename).

ResourceBar rubies chip (src/ui/index.tsx:219 res-rubies-shop wrapping res-rubies) is the correct entry point to /shop; touch target height ≈36px could benefit from hitSlop but hitSlop=6 is already present.

SkinShop.tsx correctly gates buy CTA by canBuy (owned/rubies) and by equipped state (button becomes 'Indossata' disabled) — equip is idempotent when already-equipped. Toast 'Skin indossata' visible in /tmp/it9_shop_after.png.

No deprecated Expo packages introduced (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). Only console warnings are RN-web CSS-shim deprecations (pointerEvents/textShadow/tintColor/shadow*), consistent with prior iterations and non-blocking.

Test module teardown re-equips canonical lord_frost_warden + castle_dragon_keep and restores lord_name='Sir Aldric'. Frontend flows also unequipped/re-equipped and renamed then restored. QA account state left as spec: hero.name='Sir Aldric', lord_skin=lord_frost_warden, castle_skin=castle_dragon_keep (verified via /api/profile at teardown).
